string.text: Speeds up the knife-cut animation itself when FDDA Redone's mutant skinning is installed. Above 1x we swap in our own cut sound pitched to match (since the vanilla one can't be sped up to match) and skip all camera motion tied to the cut.
Crouch when the knife-cut starts and stand back up when it ends. Only applies if you were standing.

Aim the camera at a fixed point on the mutant for the whole knife-cut, including crouch and stand-up. Replaces FDDA's mutant-skin look-at when enabled; does not affect body search or human corpse looting.
How far above the mutant's spine to aim. Higher values tilt the view up so the knife sits over the body.
Knife light or heavy attack on a dead mutant takes all parts (loot claims still apply) and plays a left-hand world grab after a short delay. Use on a corpse keeps normal FDDA skinning.
Wait this long after a successful slash-loot before the left-hand grab anim, so the knife swing can finish. 0 plays immediately.
